about_the_game:
Scrongly is a free poker themed roguelite deckbuilding game inspired by Balatro.

Make one card straight flushes, blow up your whole deck with bombs, play seven card poker hands, and much more!

  • Start with a standard deck of 52 cards, or use one of the unlockable decks

  • Earn chips by playing strong poker hands

  • Spend those chips between rounds in the shop on new cards to add to your deck, many of which you won't find in a typical deck

  • You can also purchase Baubles, which change your run in significant ways, like letting you earn chips for discarding aces, or giving multiplier bonuses to hands that contain a lot of face cards

  • Lastly, you can purchase unique zodiacs for all 18 playable hand types, from high card to seven of a kind. Zodiacs improve the power of all played hands that contain that hand type, so that you can transition into higher tier hands without losing your investment

  • Ten difficulties to climb through

  • Boss levels that will challenge your builds

  • Variants system that lets you play the game the way you want to. Like always having a certain Bauble? You can start the game with it. Want Zodiacs to be more powerful and cost less? You can do that. Change your starting deck, the efficacy of special cards, the score thresholds, and a multitude of other options

  • Daily games show off some of the power of the Variants system and have a set seed each day. Compare your score with your friends!

  • Stats tracking and old games are stored, so you can see how far you've progressed

  • Unlockable Baubles

  • Save game system lets you play at your pace

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
